entities.summary: Ulrike Rosenbach is a video artist from Germany. Rose Bach works with videotapes, installations and performances. She was one of the first artists from Germany to use video for experiments with electronic images. Her videotapes critique the traditional representation of women and help formulate the identity of women from a feminist perspective. Ulrike Rosenbach was a painters & sculptors from Bad Salzdetfurth (b. 1943-12-29, Bad Salzdetfurth). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
